dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I'm going to clean the living room now.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈkliːn ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ ˌruːm ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! You don't need to vacuum. Just sweep the floor.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! juː ˈdoʊnt ˈniːd tə ˈvækjuːm. ˈdʒʌst ˈswiːp ðə ˈflɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. Do I need to mop it, too?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. duː aɪ ˈniːd tə ˈmɑːp ɪt, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not the living room. But you need to mop the kitchen floor. It's very dirty.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ ˌruːm. bʌt juː ˈniːd tə ˈmɑːp ðə ˈkɪtʃən ˈflɔːr. ɪts ˈvɛri ˈdɜːrti.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Please dust them. But you don't need to do the table. I've already wiped it.
dialogue.reading: ˈpliːz ˈdʌst ðɛm. bʌt juː ˈdoʊnt ˈniːd tə ˈduː ðə ˈteɪbəl. aɪv ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈwaɪpt ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Great. Do we need to buy anything for cleaning?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. duː wiː ˈniːd tə ˈbaɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ fər ˈkliːnɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, we need to buy some soap for the floor.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, wiː ˈniːd tə ˈbaɪ sʌm ˈsoʊp fər ðə ˈflɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'll get some at the supermarket later.
dialogue.reading: aɪl ˈɡɛt sʌm ət ðə ˈsuːpərmɑːrkɪt ˈleɪtər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Now I need to clean the bathroom. That's the worst job!
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. ˈnaʊ aɪ ˈniːd tə ˈkliːn ðə ˈbæθruːm. ðæts ðə ˈwɜːrst ˈdʒɑːb!
